expected.fmt:
import expect_equal from "@std/test/test.ms"

enum Outcome:
	Ready(value: Int)
	Failed(reason: String)

fn score(outcome: Outcome) Int:
	match outcome:
		Ready(value):
			return value
		Failed(_):
			return 0

test "alternative result":
	expect_equal(score(Outcome.Ready(8)), 8)?
	expect_equal(score(Outcome.Failed("unavailable")), 0)?
